summary: Thursday 22 Oct was a broad risk-off day: the Nasdaq fell about 2.6% and the Philadelphia semiconductor index about 6% after Meta, Tesla and Lam Research results revived worries about AI spending, and the US 10-year yield dropped to roughly 4.96%. Asia sold off earlier (KOSPI about -3.5%, Hang Seng about -3% intraday) and Friday brought further falls in Tokyo and Seoul, with Taiwan closed for Typhoon Champi. Brent settled near $111 and touched $114 on Friday on Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia, while uranium and nuclear-power equities dropped sharply. Turkey's central bank cut its rate by 100 bp to 36% and the Philippines raised its rate to 5.50%; France's 10-year yield moved above 5% ahead of a Moody's review.

headlines.story: AI-linked stocks slide after Meta, Tesla and Lam Research results
headlines.summary: The Nasdaq fell about 2.6% and the Philadelphia semiconductor index about 6% on Thursday after earnings revived worries about AI spending, with Lam Research citing supply-chain limits on its outlook and Asian chip names falling earlier in the day.

coverage.title: Wall Street Sinks as Nasdaq Falls Over 2% on AI Cost Worries

Lam Research Sinks 9% as Supply Constraints Cap Outlook; Applied Materials Drops 6%, ASML Holding Falls 4%
